description:
Class representing a drop cap. A drop cap is a large initial letter that is split off from a paragraph into a
separate framed paragraph.

Clear.description: Removes the drop cap, merging the drop cap letter back into the paragraph text.

GetClassType.description: Returns the type of the ApiDropCap class.

GetDistanceFromText.description:
Returns the distance between the drop cap and the paragraph text measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of
an inch).

GetLinesToDrop.description: Returns the number of lines that the drop cap occupies.

GetParent.description: Returns the parent paragraph that holds the drop cap letter.

SetDistanceFromText.description:
Sets the distance between the drop cap and the paragraph text measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an
inch).

params.description: The distance between the drop cap and the paragraph text. Must be a non-negative number.
params.name: distance

SetFontFamily.description: Sets the font family of the drop cap letter.

params.description: The font family name used for the drop cap letter.
params.name: fontFamily

SetLinesToDrop.description: Sets the number of lines that the drop cap occupies. The drop cap letter is resized accordingly.

params.description: The number of lines that the drop cap occupies. Must be a number greater than 0.
params.name: lines

params.description: The drop cap type: "none" removes the drop cap, "drop" placesit within the text, "margin" places it in the margin.
params.name: position

returns.description: Returns null if the drop cap was removed with "none".
